reason: A web GUI Git panel for managing branches and repository changes, performing documented Git operations, and viewing commit history as an interactive graph.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面中提供 Git 分支、提交、暂存、同步操作及提交图谱查看功能。
summaries.en: A DSH Web panel for managing Git branches and changes, synchronizing repositories, and viewing commit history as an interactive graph.

capabilities: Reads Git repository status, branches, remotes, and commit history
Switches, checks out, renames, deletes, merges, pulls, fetches, commits, pushes, and stashes Git changes
Displays branch relationships and commit history as an interactive graph
